Employment Model: Full-time, Fixed-Term Contract
​Contract Duration: End date up to March 2027
​Location: Dublin
Salary: €65k - €85k DOE

​Gi Group Ireland is currently recruiting a skilled and driven Construction Site Manager on behalf of our client. This is a site-based position located in Dublin, tasked with overseeing a major commercial project from daily operations through to completion.

​Core Responsibilities

  • ​Responsible for the secure opening and closing of the construction site each day.
  • ​Direct and supervise all day-to-day activities taking place on-site.
  • ​Seamlessly manage and align the schedules of all onsite sub-contractors and material suppliers.

job.title: 4D Planning & Visualisation Specialist
job.description:
4D Planning & Visualisation Specialist
Location: Dublin
Job Type: Full-Time
Sector: Construction / BIM / Digital Construction
Salary: €65k - €90k DOE

About the Role
Our client is a leading construction company operating across Ireland, the UK and Northern Europe, delivering complex projects across sectors including data centres, life sciences, aviation, high-value manufacturing and critical logistics.

Due to continued growth, they are looking to appoint an experienced 4D Planning & Visualisation Specialist to join their BIM and Digital Construction team in Dublin.

This is an excellent opportunity for a BIM, VDC, planning or digital construction professional with experience in 4D construction sequencing, BIM coordination and visualisation to play a key role in developing innovative tender submissions and digital construction methodologies.

The Role
Reporting to the BIM Manager, you will work closely with the BIM, planning, estimating, design and operational teams to develop high-quality 4D construction simulations and visual content.

You will take construction programmes, BIM models, drawings and logistics information and translate them into clear, engaging visual sequences that demonstrate how complex projects can be safely and efficiently delivered.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-quality 4D construction simulations for tender submissions.
  • Create visual construction sequences aligned with project programmes, logistics strategies and phasing plans.
  • Work closely with planners, bid managers, estimators, design managers and operational teams to develop practical construction methodologies.
  • Interpret Primavera P6, Microsoft Project and similar construction programmes and convert programme logic into visual timelines.
  • Integrate BIM models, construction drawings, temporary works and logistics information into coordinated 4D animations.
  • Support the development of construction methodologies, access strategies, crane studies, site logistics and commissioning sequences.
  • Produce visual content for client presentations, tender interviews and technical submissions.
  • Coordinate with architects, engineers and consultants to ensure model accuracy and consistency throughout bid development.
  • Identify sequencing, logistics and buildability risks through digital construction reviews and assist in developing practical solutions.
  • Maintain organised digital workflows, model version control and project documentation.
  • Support the wider Bid Team by producing engaging visual material that clearly communicates proposed construction methodologies.
  • Work with BIM and VDC teams to continually improve digital workflows, templates and visualisation standards.
  • Keep up to date with developments in 4D planning, digital construction, visualisation and emerging technologies.
  • Explore opportunities to utilise AI, automation and other digital tools to improve tender and construction workflows.
  • Support knowledge sharing and mentoring within the Digital Construction team where appropriate.


The successful candidate will ideally have:

  • A Level 7/8 qualification in BIM, Digital Construction, Engineering, Architecture or a related discipline.
  • At least 2 years' relevant industry experience.
  • Experience within a main contractor, construction or fit-out environment is highly advantageous.
  • Practical experience producing 4D construction simulations and sequencing visualisations.
  • Working knowledge of Autodesk Revit and Navisworks.
  • Experience interpreting construction programmes and converting programme logic into accurate visual sequences.
  • Knowledge of Primavera P6, Microsoft Project or equivalent planning software.
  • Understanding of BIM processes, model coordination and digital construction workflows.
  • Experience integrating 3D models, drawings, logistics plans and construction methodologies.
  • An understanding of construction logistics, temporary works, crane strategies, access planning and commissioning sequences.
  • Experience with Common Data Environments such as Autodesk Construction Cloud, BIM 360, Viewpoint or Asite is desirable.
  • Experience with visualisation, rendering, video editing or motion graphics software such as Twinmotion, Lumion, Unreal Engine or After Effects would be advantageous.
  • Revit modelling experience is desirable.
  • Strong Microsoft Office and presentation skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • A proactive, self-motivated approach with the ability to work effectively under pressure.


What's on Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Pension.
  • Life assurance.
  • Healthcare.
  • Opportunity to work on major, high-profile construction projects.
  • Career development within a growing BIM and Digital Construction function.
  • Exposure to innovative digital construction, 4D planning and visualisation technologies.
  • The opportunity to work alongside experienced BIM, VDC, planning, design and construction professionals.

Reporting to: Pre-Construction Manager
Location: Mayo


Role Summary
This role leads the technical submittal process for HVAC equipment and ductwork packages, turning design intent into procurement-ready schedules and client-approvable technical submissions. You will coordinate across design, estimating, procurement, suppliers, and site teams to ensure technical compliance, timely approvals, and smooth handover from pre-construction to delivery.



Core Responsibilities

  • Validate scope, allowances, and technical assumptions with the Estimating Team during bid and post-award phases.
  • Translate the procurement strategy into a submittal plan (packages, priorities, sequencing, long-lead items).
  • Identify technical and commercial risks early (non-compliance, missing info, programme conflicts) and escalate with solutions.
  • Build compliant submittal packs including datasheets, performance data, drawings, certifications, and technical clarifications.
  • Manage the full review cycle: internal review → vendor review → client/consultant submission → comments → resubmission → approval.
  • Ensure each submission is traceable back to the project specification and drawings, clearly calling out any deviations or alternatives.
  • Drive response timelines with vendors/consultants to keep submissions moving.
  • Interrogate design information (drawings/models/specs) and raise RFIs where gaps or clashes affect procurement or install.
  • Maintain an auditable RFI log with owners, dates, status and impact (cost/programme/technical).
  • Participate in client/consultant coordination meetings, presenting issues clearly and pushing for decisions.
  • Issue “approved for procurement” packs to the Procurement Team with clear scope, approved selections, and constraints.
  • Support purchasing by technically assessing vendor offers for compliance, lead time, access/maintenance and install requirements.
  • Provide ongoing technical support to the Site/Installation Team during installation—resolving equipment/ductwork queries and ensuring the approved solution is installed.
  • Own document control for technical submissions: revision control, transmittals, comment resolution, and approval status reporting.
  • Keep registers accurate and project-ready for audits, handover and O&M inputs.


Experience & Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years’ experience in HVAC/building services within a contractor, specialist subcontractor, OEM, or consultancy environment.
  • Strong practical understanding of ductwork and HVAC equipment submittal requirements and approval workflows.
  • Demonstrable experience producing equipment schedules and ductwork schedules suitable for procurement and construction delivery.
  • Solid knowledge of DW144 and SMACNA (fabrication/installation standards and what “good” looks like on submissions).
  • Comfortable interpreting drawings/models and turning them into actionable package scopes.

  • Structured, deadline-driven approach with strong prioritisation across multiple projects/packages.
  • Clear communicator: can write concise technical clarifications and manage client/vendor conversations professionally.
  • Detail-focused with strong revision discipline (submittals live or die on version control).
  • Proactive problem-solver who can unblock RFIs/submittals and keep procurement on track.
  • Good understanding of construction sequencing and the knock-on effect of late approvals.
